# Launchy Image Converter

> Launchy's in-browser image converter. It turns JPG, PNG, HEIC and other images into WebP files, or traces logos into SVG vectors, turns every PDF page or slide into its own image, with SEO alt text, clean file names and ready-made HTML. Images never leave the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://launchy-img-converter.vercel.app/): Upload images or a PDF, pick WebP or SVG, set quality, remove solid backgrounds, name all files at once, add alt text, then download each file or all of them as a ZIP.
